text: {"text":"Two concerns pull in opposite directions: the argument for updating and the argument for restraint. 1) The proposed update changes the cache lifetime from five minutes to fifteen minutes. 2) A twenty-four-hour benchmark observed eighteen percent fewer origin requests; that is relevant evidence, but the narrower problem is that it did not measure stale-read incidence—one dial remains dark. 3) My current recommendation is bounded: approve only a canary deployment; require stale-read telemetry before broader rollout."}
